paragraphs.source_en: Castle Stair was a street with steps, a broad white stone way that led up from the Wolf’s Den by the water to the New Castle on its hill. Marble mermaids lit the way as Davos climbed, bowls of burning whale oil cradled in their arms. When he reached the top, he turned to look behind him. From here he could see down into the harbors. Both of them. Behind the jetty wall, the inner harbor was crowded with war galleys. Davos counted twenty-three. Lord Wyman was a fat man, but not an idle one, it seemed.

units.source_en: Castle Stair was a street with steps, a broad white stone way that led up from the Wolf’s Den by the water to the New Castle on its hill.
Marble mermaids lit the way as Davos climbed, bowls of burning whale oil cradled in their arms.
When he reached the top, he turned to look behind him.
From here he could see down into the harbors.
Behind the jetty wall, the inner harbor was crowded with war galleys.
Lord Wyman was a fat man, but not an idle one, it seemed.

paragraphs.source_en: The gates of the New Castle had been closed, but a postern opened when he shouted, and a guard emerged to ask his business. Davos showed him the black and gold ribbon that bore the royal seals. “I need to see Lord Manderly at once,” he said. “My business is with him, and him alone.”
